summary: Pre-school class to year 9, usually with an integrated fritidshem for F-3 (or F-6). By law the school needs the premises and equipment its purpose requires, a staffed school library on its own unit (from 2025-07-01), elevhälsa and free school meals. Room sizes come from municipal programmes. Uppsala's 2019 programme gives about 10 m² BRA per pupil including the sports hall (9 m² without it). Malmö plans 16 m² BTA per pupil. Needs differ by stage: F-3 needs home bases and nearby outdoor play. Years 4-6 add slöjd, music and hem- och konsumentkunskap. Years 7-9 add science labs, more specialist rooms and a pupil hang-out space. Outdoor friyta (Boverket 30 m²/pupil; Malmö 15 m²/pupil) and a sports hall (often shared or off-site) are the usual site blockers.

regulatory.bbr_verksamhetsklass_source: BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 11 § (Vk2A) and 12 § (Vk2B): spaces for people without good knowledge of the premises who can get themselves to safety and are awake, including spaces for pupils in schools. 2A applies up to 150 persons and 2B above 150. Fritidshem for young children inside the school follows the school class. A förskola placed in the school is Vk5A (see preschool). Travel distances, egress and other general fire rules are in cross_cutting.json.

key_laws.ref: Skollagen (2010:800) 2 kap. 35 § (premises and equipment needed for the education's purpose)
Skollagen 2 kap. 24 a-24 d §§ (skolbibliotek on the pupil's own skolenhet, staffed), inserted by SFS 2024:1072, in force 2025-07-01; replaces repealed 2 kap. 36 §
Skollagen 2 kap. 25 § (elevhälsa: medical, psychological, psychosocial and special-needs support; access to skolläkare, skolsköterska, psykolog, kurator, specialpedagog/speciallärare)
Skollagen 10 kap. 10 § (free, nutritious school meals in grundskola)
Plan- och bygglagen (2010:900) 8 kap. 9-11 §§ (friyta) and Boverket BFS 2015:1 FRI
AFS 2023:12 Utformning av arbetsplatser, kap. 3 (personalutrymmen; allmänt råd 38 § notes personalutrymmen can be outdoors, especially for pupils)
Förordning (EG) nr 852/2004 (food hygiene, registration of school kitchen)

permits: Bygglov for change of use (PBL 9 kap. 15 § 1, from 2025-12-01; see cross_cutting.json), tested against the detaljplan (S) and PBL 8 kap. 9 § friyta
Anmälan för hälsoskydd to the municipal environment committee before start (FMH 38 §)
Registration of the school kitchen (EU 852/2004 art. 6) at least two weeks before start
Grease separator approval by the municipal VA organisation for a cooking kitchen
Fire-protection design for Vk2A/2B, including assembly-type spaces (dining hall, sports hall)
For an independent school: Skolinspektionen approval of the huvudman (godkännande), which reviews premises
regulatory.operator_oversight: Skolinspektionen; municipal miljönämnd (health protection); municipal livsmedelskontroll (kitchen)

gross_m2_per_unit.source: Malmö stad 'Friytor vid förskolor och skolor' (rev. 2021-12-16) p. 13: grundskola BTA can be estimated at about 16 m² BTA per pupil, which allows Malmö miljöförvaltningen's recommended classroom of at least 65 m² for 30 pupils. Uppsala kommun 'Funktionsprogram för grundskolans lokaler', nämndversion 2019-03-01, Bilaga 'Lokalprogram, översikt' (stödmaterial) p. 27/27: 10.0-10.1 m² BRA per pupil including the sports hall (9.0-9.1 excluding), for F-6 630, F-9 900 and F-9 1 170 pupils. The two figures use different area measures. Hässleholm's lokalförsörjningsplan 2022-2026 (p. 25) uses a riktvärde of 15.6 m² per pupil, area measure not stated in the passage.

group_size.source: No legal class size. Uppsala 2019 funktionsprogram AR: F.3 (p. 20): the home base must allow gathering in groups of 30. Uppsala's lokalprogram uses home bases of 90 pupils (3 × 30).

staff_per_unit.source: About 12.0 pupils per full-time teacher in grundskola, 2024/25 (Skolverket, 'Pedagogisk personal i skola och vuxenutbildning läsåret 2024/25'). Skolverket says it stopped publishing this ratio from 2024/25 because of uncertainty. Teachers only; fritidshem, elevhälsa, kitchen, cleaning and admin staff come on top.

occupancy.hourly_presence_note: Morning and afternoon tail is fritidshem (F-3/F-6). Sports hall, dining hall and some specialist rooms are often let to associations in evenings and weekends. Uppsala (2015 p. 8, 2019 RE: F.1, ID: F.2) explicitly plans for this.

spaces.label_en: Home-base teaching area (classrooms, group rooms, shared area, pantry)
spaces.label_sv: Hemvist: pedagogisk area (lärosalar, grupprum, allrum, pentry)

required.basis: Skollagen 2 kap. 35 § (premises needed for the education's purpose). The law gives no size and no classroom count.

size.count: pupils (BRA); home bases of 90 pupils

Single classroom: Uppsala 2015 programme p. 11, lärosalar not smaller than 60 m² (exceptions possible in conversions with written justification); Malmö p. 13 cites miljöförvaltningen's recommendation of at least 65 m² for 30 pupils.

spaces.shareable_note: Evening courses and civic use. Uppsala 2015 p. 8 expects school premises to be used as medborgarhus and for evening courses. One or two home bases near the entrance ease after-hours use (Uppsala 2019 p. 11).
spaces.notes: Fritidshem is integrated in the home base in Uppsala's programme (2019 p. 8), so there is no separate fritids area. Uppsala's home base contains lärosalar, allrum and grupprum, kapprum, hygiene spaces and staff workplaces. Stockholm's 2024 revision of its lokalprogram adds separate space for särskilda undervisningsgrupper (Stockholm utbildningsnämnden lokalförsörjningsplan 2025-2027 bilaga 4, p. 14); no m² is public there.

Other arrangements (another school unit of the huvudman, the public library, or contracting out) are allowed only for särskilda skäl. 24 d §: staffed to the extent needed. The former 2 kap. 36 § is repealed.

required.basis: Slöjd, bild and teknik are compulsory subjects in Lgr22 and the timplan. Skollagen 2 kap. 35 § requires the premises and equipment needed. No law gives room standards.

spaces.notes: Wood and metal slöjd needs dust and chip extraction, three-phase power and noise separation. Uppsala 2015 p. 10 assigns slöjd to years 4-6 onward.

required.basis: Musik is a compulsory subject (Lgr22). Skollagen 2 kap. 35 § requires premises. No size in law.

size.count: 80 m² for 630 pupils (F-6); 120 m² for 900 and 1 170
size.source: Uppsala 2019 lokalprogram översikt p. 27

required.basis: Biologi, fysik and kemi with experiments are compulsory (Lgr22). Skollagen 2 kap. 35 § requires premises and equipment. No size in law.

size.count: F-9 900 pupils: 105 m²; F-9 1 170 (extended 7-9): 170 m². F-6: within combined 'Slöjd, Teknik och NO' 290 m².

spaces.notes: Requires a fume cupboard with its own exhaust and ventilated chemical storage. Fume-cupboard and chemical-storage requirements are not sourced here; check Arbetsmiljöverket's chemical rules. This is the main F-6 vs 7-9 difference in services.

required.basis: Hem- och konsumentkunskap is a compulsory subject (Lgr22). Skollagen 2 kap. 35 § requires premises. No size in law.

spaces.notes: Several kitchen units with sinks, hobs, extraction and a washing machine. Uppsala 2015 p. 10 lists HKK as a need from years 4-6, yet the 2019 F-6 programme has no HKK room. Presumably F-6 pupils use a nearby school's room. See open_questions.

required.basis: Idrott och hälsa is compulsory in every year (Lgr22 / timplan). Skollagen 2 kap. 35 § requires access to the needed premises. Access is required, not ownership; the hall may be off-site or shared.

size.count: pupils (BRA), including the hall's plant, substation and shafts
size.source: Uppsala 2019 lokalprogram översikt p. 27 ('Idrott inkl drift-, UC/fläktrum, schakt' 630/900/1 170 m²). Uppsala 2015 p. 11: three standard hall sizes, access decided per project. Malmö friyta guideline p. 13: gymnastikhall based on a basketball court 18 × 26 m, sporthall on a handball court 20 × 40 m. Built next to the school on the same property; in exceptional cases up to 500 m away if the route is traffic-safe.

spaces.shareable_note: Uppsala 2019 ID: F.2: the hall shall be lettable to associations through the municipal booking system. ID: R.1: separate entrance for evening and weekend use.
spaces.notes: An 18 × 26 m column-free hall almost never fits inside an office structure, so plan for off-site or a new-build annex. The clear height for a sports hall is not stated in the reviewed sources (strength none). Changing rooms need individual changing and showering options (Uppsala 2019 ID: T.2) and separate teacher changing rooms (ID: R.2). Swimming is part of the subject but uses public pools.

spaces.label_en: Schoolyard (friyta for play and outdoor stay)
spaces.label_sv: Skolgård / friyta för lek och utevistelse

required.basis: PBL 8 kap. 9 § andra stycket (sufficiently large friyta suitable for play and outdoor stay on or near a tomt with premises for school or fritidshem); 8 kap. 10-11 §§ for built tomter i skälig utsträckning; friyta has priority over parking

size.count: pupils; Boverket: total preferably more than 3 000 m²
size.source: Boverket rapport 2015:8 'Gör plats för barn och unga!', faktaruta 10, p. 42: '30 m2 friyta per barn i grundskolan'; total friyta should preferably exceed 3 000 m². BFS 2015:1 sets no number. Malmö stad friyta guideline (rev. 2021) p. 12: ambition 15 m² per pupil for all grades. Under heavy exploitation pressure, with a park within 500 m, 12-15 m² per pupil may be tested in the detaljplan, provided there is at least 3 000 m² contiguous (schools above 200 pupils) and F-3 is scheduled to get at least 25 m² per pupil at breaks. The F-6 / 7-9 difference is about location, not size.

constraints.direct_link_to_building: F-6 at the building; 7-9 direct or near connection

spaces.shareable_note: Uppsala 2015 p. 12: schoolyards are used before and after school, evenings, weekends and holidays.
spaces.notes: Boverket p. 44 (citing BFS 2015:1): for förskoleklass, school up to year 6 and fritidshem the friyta should be at the building. For years 7-9 it should be at or near the building, reachable by pupils on their own without crossing a trafficked street. Roof friyta counts only as complementary. Uppsala 2015 p. 12: the schoolyard must have space for outdoor sport (ball courts, running tracks). AFS 2023:12 67 § allmänt råd: schoolyards should have enough shade.

variants.label: F-6 school (lågstadium + mellanstadium)
variants.changes: Uppsala F-6 630 pupils: combined 'Slöjd, Teknik och NO' 290 m², no separate NO lab, no HKK room, music 80 m², library 80 m², total 10.0 m² BRA/pupil incl. sports hall. Friyta at the building; fritidshem integrated. Uppsala 2015 p. 6 faktaruta: F-3 school of 120 pupils 9.0 m² programme area per pupil; F-6 of 360 pupils 7.5.

variants.label: Years 7-9 (högstadium) or F-9 with extended 7-9
variants.changes: Adds NO lab (105-170 m²), HKK (80 m²), larger slöjd/bild/teknik (370-390 m²), pupil hang-out space. Uppsala 2015 programme p. 6: a mellan-högstadium school of 480 pupils has 8.0 m² programme area per pupil. Friyta may be near the building rather than at it.

variants.label: Tillagningskök
variants.changes: Cooks all components on site, possibly for other schools as well. Needs kitchen exhaust to roof, grease separator (ABVA; SS-EN 1825), goods reception, cold and dry stores, special-diet zone, kitchen staff changing. Registered food establishment.

variants.label: Mottagningskök
variants.changes: Food partly cooked elsewhere and completed and served on site (Uppsala 2019 p. 12). Same Uppsala functional level (3 dishes, 5 salads, snacks). Less exhaust. Grease separator depends on the municipality (Årjäng exempts receiving-only kitchens; Växjö and Kristinehamn list them). Still registered under EU 852/2004.

variants.label: Sports hall off-site or shared
variants.changes: Malmö allows exceptionally up to 500 m away if the route is traffic-safe (p. 13). Removes about 1.0 m² BRA per pupil from the building but adds timetable and travel time.

typical_blockers: Friyta: 15-30 m² per pupil plus a contiguous area of about 3 000 m² is rarely available next to an office building.
Sports hall: an 18 × 26 m or 20 × 40 m column-free volume cannot be made inside a typical office frame.
Egress and stair capacity for several hundred pupils moving at once, and Vk2B status for schools over 150 persons.
Dining hall plus cooking kitchen: exhaust to roof, grease separator, goods delivery.
Specialist rooms (slöjd, NO, HKK) need extraction, drainage and high power, concentrated in a few rooms.
Classrooms of at least 60-65 m² with daylight, versus deep office floors and tight column grids.
Detaljplan change from office use to S (skola).
typical_enablers: Office cellular rooms map well to teacher workrooms, admin, elevhälsa and group rooms.
A large ground floor can take the dining hall, library and entrance as a shared 'torg'.
Using a receiving kitchen and an off-site sports hall removes the two heaviest services and structural demands.
Proximity to a park within 500 m (Malmö accepts 12-15 m²/pupil in that case).

open_questions: Stockholm (SISAB / utbildningsförvaltningen) lokalprogram with areariktvärden is referenced but not public in the reviewed documents. Obtain it for a second programme source beside Uppsala.
Uppsala's 2019 F-6 programme has no HKK room although HKK is taught before year 7 under the timplan. Check how F-6 schools cover HKK (shared room at another school?).
No source gives a sports-hall clear height or exact gross area. Uppsala's 1.0 m² BRA/pupil includes plant. Look up Uppsala's 'Lokalförteckning idrott' or the Riksidrottsförbundet hall dimensions.
Sports hall: Malmö's 18 × 26 m (gymnastikhall) vs 20 × 40 m (sporthall). Which one is needed depends on school size; not specified.
Dining hall per-seat area and number of sittings: Uppsala gives only 0.5 m² BRA per enrolled pupil.

Fire class threshold wording in BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 11-12 §§ ('verksamheter med fler än 150 personer') should be checked against the official BFS text: does the threshold apply per fire compartment, per building or per operation?
Science-lab fume cupboard and chemical storage requirements (Arbetsmiljöverket chemical rules) are not sourced here.
Malmö's 16 m² BTA vs Uppsala's 10 m² BRA per pupil differ more than the BTA/BRA ratio explains. Possibly Malmö includes the sports hall and a margin. Confirm before using either as a hard target.
The pupil-teacher ratio of 12.0 (2024/25) comes from a search summary of Skolverket's publication; re-check in the PDF.
